label: update gate higher when S2/a2 favoured, lower after a1 S2 unrewarded
terms: np.tanh(belief_lo/2) ;; np.tanh(belief_lo/2)*(ep_dec>=8) ;; (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase==D1)*(prev_action==2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; isin(phase,[GO,D2])*last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase==D1)*(prev_reward==0) ;; (phase==D2)*(action==state)
explanation: Raw z of unit 2 is mostly timing (decays from ~0.91 to ~0.25 over the episode; timing R^2 0.84). Beyond timing it tracks a side preference for a2/S2: higher when the ideal-observer belief favours S2 (graded tanh(belief_lo/2), negative weight, stronger in the last two episode deciles), after an a2 choice (largest at D1), and at D2 after choosing a2 (D2 terms use the choice and state just shown, so they are observed). It is pushed down at GO/D2 after an a1->S2 unrewarded trial (about -0.08), at D1 after any unrewarded trial (-0.03) and a little at D2 after a common transition. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.47 with observed-only terms, vs all-observed reference 0.55 and the all ceiling 0.60 (policy decile alone gives 0.46), so dropping the model policy costs little. Large leftover errors are late in the episode (trials 85-95), where whole windows sit well above or below the decile baseline, which suggests episode-level drift this window cannot see. Scaling the terms by episode decile did not help.
